scripts.format:check: biome format src scripts package.json tsconfig.json biome.json vite.config.ts
scripts.format: biome format --write src scripts package.json tsconfig.json biome.json vite.config.ts
scripts.build:round4: node acceptance/scripts/run.mjs -- sh -c 'vite build --configLoader native --config round4/vite.config.ts'
scripts.test:round4: node acceptance/scripts/run.mjs -- sh -c 'node round4/review.mjs && node round4/extra.mjs'
scripts.test:a-refinement: node acceptance/scripts/run.mjs -- sh -c 'node scripts/a-refinement.mjs && node scripts/a-interactions.mjs'
scripts.build:host: node acceptance/scripts/run.mjs -- sh -c 'vite build --configLoader native --mode host --outDir integration/dist'
